issue.title: Camera server freezes up and disconnects upon taking photo or record video 3.5
issue.body:
Issue I am seeing:

Running MAVSDK 3.5.0's camera server example does not work for me as expected. The camera does show up, but after taking 1 or 2 photos or starting recording, photo/video controls freeze up and then the MAVLink camera disconnects. This was not happening on earlier versions.


I saw this both happen on ArduCopter 4.5.6 and mainline PX4 simulation. 

I also witnessed this happen on both QGC 4.4 and release candidate for 5.0.


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ccc70541-3a38-4da0-b6fb-83f6b3bdbf8c

The one major difference between my tests on PX4 and Ardupilot was that on ardupilot, occasionally the camera status would not be detected as idle, but this only sometimes happened. Ardupilot and PX4 both had the camera server freezing up issue. 

I will test on earlier versions to see if the issue exists there. I originally was using 2.14.1 and did not have this problem.

The only thing I changed on the camera server example was I set the udp port to 14550

System Specs:

Ubuntu 22.04
MAVSDK 3.5
QGC 4.4 & Mainline
Mainline PX4 & Arducopter 4.5.6

2. `sudo gdb build/examples/camera_server`

4. `thread apply all bt`
